Game Overview

Square Run puts players into a hyper-casual experience centered on leap through an endless journey with a quirky square, dodging obstacles and collecting points. Enjoy vibrant 2D visuals and addictive gameplay that challenges your reflexes and timing. With simple controls, Square Run offers quick and engaging sessions in a quest to see just how far you can go!
